issue_context.title: `scan_parquet` filter/select optimisation error
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

## Reproducible example

Unzip the attached sample files; there are three ("data0.parquet", "data1.parquet", "data2.parquet"), each with only 8 rows:
[parquet_test_files.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18028607/parquet_test_files.zip)

Update the directory in the below `scan_parquet` call to point to the unzipped parquet:
```python
import polars as pl

lf = pl.scan_parquet("~/files/data*.parquet", rechunk=True)
lf = lf.filter(
    pl.col("c0") >= date(2014,1,15), 
    pl.col("c0") <= date(2014,1,20),
)
lf = lf.select(['c0','c9','c3'])
lf.collect()
```

### Log output

```
ShapeError: unable to vstack, column names don't match: "c9" and "c3"
```

## Issue description

Applying the same query plan to the files _individually_ shows the following results:
```python
for file in (
    "~/files/data0.parquet",
    "~/files/data1.parquet",
    "~/files/data2.parquet",
):
    lf = pl.scan_parquet(file, rechunk=True)
    lf = lf.filter(
        pl.col("c0") >= date(2014,1,15), 
        pl.col("c0") <= date(2014,1,20),
    )
    lf = lf.select(['c0','c9','c3'])
    print(lf.collect())

    # shape: (0, 3)
    # ┌──────┬─────┬─────┐
    # │ c0   ┆ c9  ┆ c3  │
    # │ ---  ┆ --- ┆ --- │
    # │ date ┆ str ┆ i64 │
    # ╞══════╪═════╪═════╡
    # └──────┴─────┴─────┘
    
    # shape: (8, 3)
    # ┌────────────┬─────┬─────────┐
    # │ c0         ┆ c3  ┆ c9      │  <<< unexpected column order
    # │ ---        ┆ --- ┆ ---     │
    # │ date       ┆ i64 ┆ str     │
    # ╞════════════╪═════╪═════════╡
    # │ 2014-01-16 ┆ 0   ┆ OZWC9XE │
    # │ 2014-01-15 ┆ 411 ┆ ODJ8EAE │
    # │ 2014-01-16 ┆ 411 ┆ OGDLJJE │
    # │ 2014-01-15 ┆ 53  ┆ PXLUJGE │
    # │ 2014-01-15 ┆ 559 ┆ S893KLE │
    # │ 2014-01-20 ┆ 557 ┆ UL3ZEUE │
    # │ 2014-01-17 ┆ 411 ┆ W3JZ3TE │
    # │ 2014-01-15 ┆ 559 ┆ WF3ZMKE │
    # └────────────┴─────┴─────────┘
    
    # shape: (0, 3)
    # ┌──────┬─────┬─────┐
    # │ c0   ┆ c9  ┆ c3  │
    # │ ---  ┆ --- ┆ --- │
    # │ date ┆ str ┆ i64 │
    # ╞══════╪═════╪═════╡
    # └──────┴─────┴─────┘
```
* Note that the requested `select` column order is correct for the first/last files (which return no results), but is _incorrect_ for the middle file (which contains all of the matching rows). This points to the cause of the `ShapeError`, as the internal vstack call receives misaligned columns.

* Modifying the filter in any way (omitting it, removing one of the two conditions, or replacing it with an `is_between`) causes the query to succeed (though using `is_between` still fails on the real -much larger- data).

* Omitting the `select` or disabling `predicate_pushdown` also causes the query to succeed.

* Files were written by Polars, using `sink_parquet`.

### Expected behavior

Return the results without raising a `ShapeError`.

### Note

I think this represents a clean MWE of https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19944.

### Installed versions

<details>

Latest compiled `head` branch.

</details>

I experienced this issue too with the same pattern, `filter()` first then `select()`.

As a workaround I moved the `filter()` as an expr inside the `select()`:

```python
import polars as pl

lf = pl.scan_parquet("/tmp/files/data*.parquet", rechunk=True)
lf = lf.select(
    pl.col(["c0", "c9", "c3"]).filter(
        pl.col("c0") >= pl.date(2014, 1, 15),
        pl.col("c0") <= pl.date(2014, 1, 20),
    )
)
print(lf.collect())

# shape: (8, 3)
# ┌────────────┬─────────┬─────┐
# │ c0         ┆ c9      ┆ c3  │
# │ ---        ┆ ---     ┆ --- │
# │ date       ┆ str     ┆ i64 │
# ╞════════════╪═════════╪═════╡
# │ 2014-01-16 ┆ OZWC9XE ┆ 0   │
# │ 2014-01-15 ┆ ODJ8EAE ┆ 411 │
# │ 2014-01-16 ┆ OGDLJJE ┆ 411 │
# │ 2014-01-15 ┆ PXLUJGE ┆ 53  │
# │ 2014-01-15 ┆ S893KLE ┆ 559 │
# │ 2014-01-20 ┆ UL3ZEUE ┆ 557 │
# │ 2014-01-17 ┆ W3JZ3TE ┆ 411 │
# │ 2014-01-15 ┆ WF3ZMKE ┆ 559 │
# └────────────┴─────────┴─────┘
```

Can anybody else repro @peterbuecker-form3's MWE https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19944#issuecomment-2519877545?

It still errors for me after the fix.

```python
import polars as pl

n = 5_000_000
col1_type = pl.Int8
col2_type = pl.Int8

data = {
    'col1': [0] * n,
    'col2': [0] * n
}

df1 = pl.DataFrame(data, schema={
    'col1': col1_type,
    'col2': col2_type,
})

df2 = pl.DataFrame(data, schema={
    'col2': col2_type,
    'col1': col1_type,
})

df1.write_parquet('df1.parquet')
df2.write_parquet('df2.parquet')

df1 = pl.scan_parquet('df1.parquet')
df2 = pl.scan_parquet('df2.parquet')
df = pl.concat([df1, df2], how='diagonal_relaxed')

df.filter(pl.col('col1') >= 0).collect()
# ShapeError: unable to vstack, column names don't match: "col1" and "col2"
```
